Do not use the reserved avatar_url or phone_number inputs. FTP and Web Disk home directories are relative to the cPanel account home; the FTP directory must exist. The FTP parameter prose contains a self-referential requiredness statement; no client-side condition is inferred. Web Disk home is required when Web Disk is enabled. Digest Authentication is discouraged except for the documented Windows/self-signed compatibility case. The source declares no rollback.
